summary.intent: Make addrConn.connect and updateAddrs hand ac.mu to resetTransportAndUnlock so the Idle-to-Connecting transition is atomic with the idleness check, preventing two concurrent connection attempts (issue #7365, flaky Test/AuthorityRevive).
summary.issue_fit: Met — issue #7365's root cause (connect() released ac.mu between the idle check and resetTransport re-acquiring it) is closed at both call sites; the PR-text release note (orphaned connections) matches the fixed behavior.
summary.coverage: Complete merge-base diff of clientconn.go reviewed with callers (balancer_wrapper.go). Two concurrency safety premises (lock released exactly once with no deadlock; state is Connecting before the lock is released) were checked by a fresh verifier: both hold. Focused root-package test runs (-race, two name filters) matched no tests, so no execution evidence is claimed. The change adds no test; the PR reports 100000 clean runs of Test/AuthorityRevive, which was not repeatable here.

requirements.source: pr-body/"no concurrent requests are able to start once caller of resetTransport does some validation and calls resetTransport"
requirements.evidence: clientconn.go:906-922 connect() keeps ac.mu from the Idle check through resetTransportAndUnlock; clientconn.go:1261-1262 sets Connecting before unlocking; verifier premise-2 holds

requirements.source: issue-7365/root-cause: duplicate tryAllAddrs from parallel connect()
requirements.evidence: clientconn.go:922 and :996 no longer release ac.mu before the state moves to Connecting

requirements.source: pr-body/"Verified that Test/AuthorityRevive no longer flakes for 100000 attempts"
requirements.evidence: Author-reported measurement; not repeated here. Nothing material depends on it given the static trace.

tasks.premise: Every path through resetTransportAndUnlock releases ac.mu exactly once, and neither call site (including the goroutine handoff in updateAddrs and its deferred GracefulClose) can deadlock.
ac.state is non-Idle before ac.mu is released after connect() or updateAddrs, so a second connect() cannot start a second attempt.
